summary: First-finish smoke test for Maintenance Daily Report app. All 3 auth logins (admin/shift1/shift2) work with correct role+shift; wrong password returns 401; /auth/me works with/without token; image upload + serve via ?auth= works; full report CRUD, filters (shift+status+q), stats, and RBAC delete (operator 403 on other's report, admin 200) all pass. Frontend end-to-end flow (login quick-fill -> dashboard KPIs -> new report with image upload -> success toast + redirect -> report visible -> presentation mode slide counter -> exit) all pass.
passed: POST /api/auth/login for admin, shift1, shift2 returns token + user with correct role/shift
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer returns user; without token -> 401
POST /api/reports creates report with images[] (ReportImage objects) and returns created_by_name/created_at
DELETE /api/reports/{id} -> 403 for other operator, 200 for admin
Frontend /login quick-shift1-btn fills email/password; submit redirects to /
Dashboard shows KPI cards, filter-shift, filter-status, search-input, new-report-btn, present-mode-btn
ReportForm submit with file upload shows toast 'Laporan berhasil disimpan' and redirects; new card visible on dashboard
Presentation mode loads slide-counter '1 / 1'; exit-presentation-btn returns to dashboard
notes: POST /api/reports body must send images as full ReportImage objects (id, storage_path, original_filename, content_type), not just file id strings. Frontend does this correctly.
